record_scope_reconstruction: Two directions and locations require separation: January 17 Chile-bound obstruction at the exit of ACI Uspallata, and January 20 reported reciprocal blocking of Argentina-bound trucks on the Cristo Redentor–Los Libertadores system.

source_checks.finding: January 21 original reports deliberate blocking since the preceding day of trucks coming from Chile into Argentina, distinct from health-test queues. Exact barrier not specified.
January 26 original confirms protesters remain stopped on the Chile-bound route and describes Uspallata separately from Los Libertadores congestion.
January 18 original expressly locates protest at the exit of the Uspallata integrated-control area since late Monday; tourists and health testing are separate scopes.
January 28 primary notice changes Chilean health protocols from January 29; it does not establish a common protest-clearing endpoint.
Raw official table inspected: Uspallata cargo, Horcones and Los Libertadores have separate DMS coordinates and road addresses.
